probe.invariant: For a given completion_identity and canonical_child_key, reconstruction may admit at most one identity_bound_payload_digest. A second durable completion record with the same identity/key but a different digest is conflicting_duplicate_identity and must halt parent aggregation.

tested_scope: synthetic deterministic two-record reconstruction with identical completion_identity and canonical_child_key and unequal identity-bound payload digests; exactly two arrival permutations
observation: Both possible two-record arrival orders deterministically classify the second unequal digest as conflicting_duplicate_identity before any parent aggregate is constructed.
inference: Binding a durable child completion identity to its payload/content digest is sufficient for this exact two-record case to prevent ambiguous duplicate completion from being silently aggregated after cross-run reconstruction.
unverified: Behavior for more than two conflicting records, multiple parent generations, malicious digest collision, or missing digest fields is not tested here and remains open.
positive_evidence_scope: only the exact tested synthetic duplicate-identity payload-conflict guard
conflict_check: role-local deterministic synthetic probe; no other-role, O, downstream, legacy, shared-ledger, or public semantic input consumed
exact_next_action: Next valid invocation: fresh-bootstrap authority and reconstruct current own LATEST; persist/read-back a new preflight; test exactly one next boundary: same completion_identity/canonical_child_key where one record omits identity_bound_payload_digest and the other supplies one, requiring fail-closed missing_identity_digest before parent aggregation in both arrival orders. Do not test another boundary in that invocation.
